title: pypfda: an online particle-filter data assimilation engine in pure Python
description: pypfda is an open-source, model-agnostic online sequential-importance-resampling (SIR) particle-filter data assimilation engine. It couples to coupled Earth system models and idealized dynamical cores through a small common interface (forecast, observe, get/set_state, inflate) and implements the full assimilation cycle (cost, importance weights, tempering, maximum-weight cap, effective-sample-size diagnostics, systematic resampling, and an inflation kernel) with no offline calibration, surrogates, or lookup tables. This release (v1.0) accompanies the manuscript "Online Particle Filter Data Assimilation for AMOC Reconstruction: A Diversity-Memory Trade-off in Observing System Simulation Experiments" (Fallah et al.), submitted to Geoscientific Model Development. It ships runnable fast-slow Lorenz benchmarks and is used to drive perfect-model OSSEs in the CM2Mc-BLING and CLIMBER-X ocean cores.
